verdict.rationale: Evidence shows some autonomous behavior: Cognee can be installed as a Linear agent that answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory. It also offers data-source integrations (Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Google Drive) that index content into memory. Nothing shows a user can define their own background automations, schedules or triggers; the evidence covers fixed integrations rather than a general automation capability. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations or workflows, scheduling or triggers, documented continuous background sync or run monitoring, and independent corroboration.
